title: Maria asks to borrow less; the loan officer approves
description: A full flow with both agents. Maria changed jobs in March and got a raise last month; the application agent should complete her application after her new pay stub arrives. The bank then sends her the offer she asked for ($15,000 over 48 months). A day later she asks to borrow $12,000 instead. The offer agent cannot decide this: it should ask a loan officer and tell her a loan officer will decide, without calculating a new offer. The officer approves $12,000 over 48 months a day later, and the bank sends the revised offer; the offer agent should tell her what changed, quoting the revised offer's numbers. Two days after that she signs the revised $12,000 offer.
